{{small|(13 September 2026)}}}} | attendance = {{formatnum:{{#expr: 24381 + 2186 + 26614 + 8941 + 9014 + 2453 + 10863 + 1772 + 2791 + 5581 + 3230 + 805 + 1930 + 2398 + 5916 + 27211 + 1067 + 9059 + 1380 + 23086 + 1547 + 29575 + 1270 + 1036 + 3533 + 475 + 19545 + 16099}}}}{{Cite web|url=https://www.slgr.gr/el/schedule/|title=Fixture list for 2026-2027 season|publisher=Super League Greece|lang=el}} | average attendance = {{formatnum:{{#expr: ((243758/28) round 0)}}}} | prevseason = [[2025–26 Super League Greece|2025–26]] | nextseason = [[2027–28 Super League Greece|2027–28]] | updated = 20 September 2026 }} The '''2026–27 Super League Greece''', also known as '''Stoiximan Super League''' for sponsorship reasons,{{cite web|url=https://emea.gr/epicheiriseis/684198/stoiximan-kentrikos-chorigos-tis-super-league-gia-epomena-25-chronia|title=Stoiximan: Κεντρικός χορηγός της Super League για επόμενα 2,5 χρόνια|date=16 December 2022|language=el|location=Online}} is the 91st season of the [[Super League Greece]], the professional association football league in [[Greece]] and the highest level of the Greek football league system under the supervision of the [[Hellenic Football Federation|HFF]] established in 1927. The season also marks the 68th championship since the establishment of the 1st National Division in 1959. The 2026–27 season began on 22 August 2026.{{cite web|url=https://www.slgr.gr/el/article/apophaseis-d-s-30-3-2026/|title=Αποφάσεις Δ.Σ., 30/3/2026|date=30 March 2026|language=el|location=Online}} The winter break will begin on 21 December 2026, while the regular season will be concluded on 21 March 2027. The Championship and Europe spot play-offs as well as the Relegation play-outs are expected to begin on 3 April 2027. The league will conclude with the last match day of the Relegation Play-Outs on 23 May 2027.{{cite web|url=https://www.sport-fm.gr/article/podosfairo/superleague1/Stoiximan-Super-League-2026-27-olokliro-to-programma/5136409|title=Stoiximan Super League 2026-27: Το αναλυτικό πρόγραμμα της κανονικής περιόδου και οι ημερομηνίες-κλειδιά|date=16 July 2026|language=el|location=Online}} The draw for the fixtures took place on Thursday 16 July 2026 in [[Alimos]] and the full regular season schedule was released shortly after.{{cite web|url=https://www.slgr.gr/el/article/h-klerose-tou-protathlematos-stoiximan-super-league-2026-2027/|title=H Κλήρωση του Πρωταθλήματος Stoiximan Super League 2026-2027|date=16 July 2026|language=el|location=Online}} [[AEK Athens F.C.|AEK Athens]] are the defending champions having won their 14th title last season.{{cite web|url=https://www.slgr.gr/el/article/e-aek-protathletria-stoiximan-super-league-2025-26/|title=Η ΑΕΚ Πρωταθλήτρια Stoiximan Super League 2025-2026|date=18 May 2026|language=el|location=Online}} ==Teams== Fourteen teams compete in the league – the top twelve teams from the previous season and two teams promoted from [[2025-26 Super League Greece 2|Super League 2]].{{cite web|url=https://www.sport-fm.gr/article/podosfairo/superleague1/Stoiximan-Super-League-o-xartis-tis-sezon-2026-27/5124801|title=Stoiximan Super League: Ο χάρτης της σεζόν 2026/27|date=17 May 2026|language=el|location=Online}} [[Iraklis F.C. (Thessaloniki)|Iraklis]] returns in the [[Super League Greece|Super League]], having secured promotion from Super League 2 as north group champions, after a nine-year absence and the [[2016–17 Super League Greece|2016–17]] season.{{cite web|url=https://www.sport24.gr/football/hraklis-anagennisi-karditsas-3-1-o-giraios-nikise-tous-thessalous-sto-mats-fiesta-gia-tin-anodo-sti-stoiximan-super-league/|title=Hρακλής – Αναγέννηση Καρδίτσας 3-1: Ο Γηραιός νίκησε τους Θεσσαλούς στο ματς-φιέστα για την άνοδο στη Stoiximan Super League|date=22 March 2026|language=el|location=Online}} [[Kalamata F.C.|Kalamata]] returns in the Super League after twenty five years of absence and the [[2000–01 Alpha Ethniki|2000–01]] season, after winning the Super League 2 south championship.{{cite web|url=https://www.sport24.gr/football/panionios-kalamata-0-1-i-mavri-thiella-alose-ti-nea-smirni-kai-epestrepse-sta-salonia-meta-apo-25-xronia/|title=Πανιώνιος – Καλαμάτα 0-1: Η Μαύρη Θύελλα άλωσε 2]] after only one year in the [[Super League Greece|Super League 1]].{{cite web|url=https://www.sport24.gr/football/ael-novibet-atromitos-2-1-oi-vissini-me-psila-to-kefali-apoxairetoun-ti-stoiximan-super-league-nikontas-ton-atromito/|title=STOIXIMAN SUPER LEAGUE ΑΕΛ Novibet – In the regular season 26 matches will be played in 2 rounds of 13 match days each, where in each round all teams will compete against all others based on a draw.{{cite web|url=https://www.sdna.gr/podosfairo/1324558_soyper-ligka-egkrithike-i-prokiryxi-den-perase-gia-anadiarthrosi|title=Σούπερ Λίγκα: Εγκρίθηκε η προκήρυξη - Δεν πέρασε για αναδιάρθρωση|date=25 June 2024|language=el|location=Online}} ==Stadiums and locations== {{Location map+|Greece|width=550|float=left|caption=Locations of the '''2026–27 Super League Greece 1''' teams|places={{Location map~ |Greece |lat=38.036 |long=23.787 |label_size=80 |label='''Athens'''|position=right}} {{Location map~ |Greece |lat=40.614 |long=22.972 |label_size=80 |label='''Thessaloniki'''|position=left}} {{Location map~ |Greece |lat=37.947 |long=23.663 |label=[[Olympiacos F.C.|Olympiacos]] |position=left}} {{Location map~ |Greece |lat=37.0366 |long=22.1144 |label=[[Kalamata F.C.|Kalamata]]|position=right}} {{Location map~ |Greece |lat=38.435 |long=22.882 |label=[[Levadiakos F.C.|Levadiakos]] |position=right}} {{Location map~ |Greece |lat=38.617 |long=21.4 |label=[[Panetolikos F.C.|Panetolikos]] |position=left}} {{Location map~ |Greece |lat=37.503 |long=22.389 |label=[[Asteras Tripolis F.C.|Asteras Tripolis]] |position=left}} {{Location map~ |Greece |lat=35.337 |long=25.114 |label=[[OFI Crete F.C.|OFI]] |position=right}} {{Location map~ |Greece |lat=39.39 |long=22.95 |label=[[Volos F.C.|Volos]]| position=right}} {{Location map~ |Greece |mark=TransparentPlaceholder.png |marksize=1 |lat=35.8 |long=19.5 |label_size=80 |label= {{nowrap|'''Athens teams'''}}
